description: SQL query review — Review a SQL query: exact rule-based lint (UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, DROP/TRUNCATE, SELECT *, leading-wildcard LIKE, functions on indexed columns, NOT IN with NULLs, ORDER BY random, deep OFFSET, comma cross joins, string-built SQL injection risk) plus an AI explanation of what it does, execution steps, performance tips, index suggestions and logic bugs. Pass sql=; optional dialect= and schema= (CREATE TABLE text). Returns overall risk LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_sql_review
